outgoing.name: Arabic language
outgoing.excerpt: Makuria (Arabic: مقرة; al-Mukurra or al-Muqurra) was a kingdom located in what is today Northern Sudan and Southern Egypt.

outgoing.name: Barley
outgoing.excerpt: The main economic activity in Makuria was agriculture, with farmers growing several crops a year of barley, millet, and dates.

outgoing.name: Cattle
outgoing.excerpt: Trade between the two states flourished: Egypt sent wheat, wine, and linen south while Makuria exported ivory, cattle, ostrich feathers, and slaves.

outgoing.name: Currency
outgoing.excerpt: Makurian trade was largely by barter as the state never adopted a currency.
